units.source_text: 千重子也挑选一枝挂满嫩叶的小树枝，心情特别激动。

en.t: Chieko also chose a small branch covered with fresh young leaves, and her heart was especially stirred.

units.source_text: 她手拿杨桐，走进家里，扬起了快活的声音：

en.t: Holding the aucuba branch in her hand, she went into the house and called out in a cheerful voice:
